core_idea: A masking and curves adjustment technique is used to create a stylized 'person flash' effect in Adobe Premiere Pro.
process_steps: Import clip and cut the desired section
Duplicate the clip onto the layer above
Use the Object Mask tool on the top layer to mask out the subject
Add three cuts to the beginning of the masked layer
Apply Lumetri Color curves to the first and third clips and drag the line to the top to create a white-out effect
Add sound effects to sell the transition
key_insight: Layering a masked subject and using Lumetri Color curves to keyframe exposure allows for a controlled, clean 'flash' effect without needing complex external plugins.

core_idea: Use the 'Maintain Audio Pitch' feature in Adobe Premiere Pro to stretch or shrink sound effects without distorting the audio pitch.

key_insight: You can manipulate the timing and length of sound effects to perfectly fit your edit by enabling 'Maintain Audio Pitch', avoiding the 'warped' or 'crushed' robot-like sound common with standard time-stretching.
